photos.name: img-8236
photos.summary: Prep station mid-mix: brown-sugar bowl and starter bowl staged on the counter with a couple of spatulas out, dog sacked out on the floor while a game plays on the TV in the background. Evening kitchen light, dough not yet assembled.

photos.name: img-8237
photos.summary: First batch of finished dough scraped into a Cambro, mixing bowls emptied out next to it with the spatula parked in the last one. Dough looks glossy and streaked with chunks.

photos.name: img-8239
photos.summary: Closer overhead of the dough in the Cambro, chocolate chunks visible throughout. Dough is soft and slumped — headed to the fridge for the overnight chill before morning bake.

photos.name: img-8242
photos.summary: Morning bake output: 16 cookies on the wire rack fresh out of the oven (uneven spacing showing) with an earlier batch already Maldon-salted and stacked in the storage bin on the left. Confectioners' sugar bowl and glaze bowl are staged in back for glaze work.
